requestedScope.description: A scope requested for the authorization grant that is created when the document is signed or the request is approved.

resourceType.description: Kind of resource the scope covers.

appliesTo.description: Constraints identifying which resources the scope covers, for example `meteringPoint.id` (maximum 50 IDs).

allowedChanges.description: Constraints on which changes the grant permits, for example the move-in `validFrom`.

authorizationScope.description: A scope of an authorization grant, describing what the grantedTo agent is authorized to do.

capability.description: What the grant permits on the resource.
